description: The shared JsonLogic vocabulary of the Dimensions (chaosD6) data layer. Every rule, effect, skill, class, creature, item … in data/*.json carries a `logic` block written in JsonLogic (json-logic-js 2.x). Anything two entries need in the same way (Rule 24 destruction, the Rule 21 damage formula, point-buy dice, 'is in contact', the power-score formulas of the rebalance script …) lives here ONCE as a named rule and is referenced with {"rule": ["<id>", {params}]}. The logic engine (game/logic-engine.mjs) expands those references before handing the logic to json-logic-js, so the data files stay pure JSON and the semantics stay in one place. Rules tagged shared_candidate were extracted by the per-collection authoring pass (2026-10-28) from logic repeated across entries; promote them by referencing them from the mapping files.

reference_syntax.named_rule: {"rule": ["<logic_rules entry id>", {"<param>": <logic or literal>, ...}]} — expanded in place by the engine; inside a named rule {"param": "<name>"} marks where an argument goes. A missing argument falls back to the rule's `params[<name>].default`.
reference_syntax.catalog_lookup: {"entry": ["<entry id>", "<dotted path into the active version's data>"]} — read another entry's canonical data at evaluation time (e.g. {"entry": ["effect_fireball", "element_cost"]}).
reference_syntax.whole_context: {"var": ""} is the whole context object (handy to pass to params).
reference_syntax.literal_objects: json-logic-js treats every object as an operation, so a literal object/array argument to a named rule must be passed as a {"var": ...} reference into the context (the engine's rule(id, args, ctx) helper does this automatically: non-logic values are moved to ctx.__args).

custom_operations.round_half_up: round_half_up(x): 0.5 → 1, 0.4 → 0 (Math.round) — the rounding every /10 in the paper rules uses
custom_operations.includes: includes(array, value) — true if the array holds the value
custom_operations.subset_of: subset_of(array, allowed_array) — every element is allowed
custom_operations.stat_of: stat_of(unit, element_id) — the unit's stat behind an element (elements.json stat column): Vitality←elem_vitality; World←souls/time/space; Matter←air/water/earth/fire; Will←concentration/harmony
custom_operations.dice_count: dice_count(stat) — how many d6 a point-buy rolls: 6·n nearest the stat, ties to more dice (15 → 3, 8 → 1, 9 → 2)
custom_operations.semver_gt: semver_gt(a, b) — a is a later semver-ish string than b
custom_operations.entry: entry(id, path) — catalog lookup, see reference_syntax.catalog_lookup
custom_operations.rule: rule(id, params) — named rule reference, expanded before evaluation (never reaches json-logic-js)
custom_operations.root: root(path) — read from the ROOT context even inside map / filter / all / none / some (whose bodies only see the current item). Pass {"root": "caster"} rather than {"var": "caster"} to a named rule that iterates (rule_21_delta_damage, stat_buy_emissions_needed, elements_not_disabled).
custom_operations.max_of: max_of(array) — largest number in the array (json-logic's max takes varargs, not an array)
custom_operations.min_of: min_of(array) — smallest number in the array

context_shape.description: What the `logic` blocks may read with {"var": ...}. Not every evaluation supplies every field: validation gets entry/proposal/catalog, prerequisites & outcomes get the battle context.
context_shape.entry: { id, collection, name, tags, version, data } — the entry being evaluated (its ACTIVE version)
context_shape.proposal: { version, weight, status, origin, parent_version, data, logic? } — the candidate new version under validation
context_shape.caster: unit — who plays the card / owns the permanent
context_shape.defender: unit — the unit the maths is being done against
context_shape.unit: { id, name, kind: 'character'|'creature', alliance: 'player'|'npc_a'|'npc_b', stats: {vitality, world, matter, will}, life, life_max, tile: {q, r}, action: 'A'|'B'|'M'|'P'|'EP'|'EM', permanents: [entry_id], tokens: [{kind, elem, value}], disabled_elems: [element_id], actions_per_round, hand_size }
context_shape.elements: [element_id] — the elements of the cast under evaluation
context_shape.cast: { step, of, every (∀ double cast), aura, kept: [die|null], bank: number, need: number }
context_shape.die: number — the point-buy die just rolled (Rule 24 / 12 / 20 checks)
context_shape.scores: { current: number, proposal: number } — rebalance pass

entry_logic_shape.description: The `logic` object every version in data/*.json carries (sibling of `data`). All fields optional; empty arrays are fine.
entry_logic_shape.description_field: logic.description — a longer, machine-oriented description of the entry (what it checks, what it changes, edge cases, pc-game overrides)
entry_logic_shape.prerequisites: [ { id, description, when: <logic over the battle context> } ] — ALL must be true before the entry may be used / cast / triggered
entry_logic_shape.effects: [ { id, description, target: 'caster'|'target'|'all_enemies'|'everyone'|'tile'|'proposal', value: <logic computing the number / list / object>, unit?: 'damage'|'life'|'die'|'actions'|'cards'|'tokens'|'hexes'|'stat' } ] — the outcome maths
entry_logic_shape.validation: [ { id, description, assert: <logic over {entry, proposal, catalog}> } ] — invariants every NEW version of this entry must satisfy; the engine also applies collection_validation[collection]
entry_logic_shape.references: [ logic_rules entry id ] — the named rules this entry relies on (filled by the engine's lint if missing)

collection_validation.description: Named rules the engine runs on EVERY proposal of a collection, before the entry's own validation.

power_score.description: governance_rebalance_script.power_score as JsonLogic — the rebalance script (tools/rebalance.mjs) evaluates these with {entry, data} per collection and compares proposal vs canonical.

entries.name: Rule 24 — destroy a permanent / token
entries.description: A point-buy die destroys a permanent token when the die is at least the token's power. Permanents with FIXED power (Summoning, Golems, Elementals, Resurrect, Sleep, Confusion, Possess) need a 6. User ruling 2026-10-30: a class card is destroyed COLOUR by colour — pass `is_class_card` true and the die must be a 6 for that one colour (see class_colour_falls); once every colour is down the card goes to its owner's archive (class_colours_all_down).

die.description: the point-buy die rolled against the token

power.description: the token's power (its die at placement, or 6 if fixed)

entries.name: Fixed permanent power 6
entries.description: Permanents that are 'always cast with tokens of value 6': the class card (Rule 9) and the stat-buy summons (Summoning, Golems, Elementals, Resurrect/Death Ward). No die is rolled at placement.

entries.name: Rule 21 — effect delta damage
entries.description: Damage of a completed effect cast: for every element of the cast take max(caster stat − defender stat, 0), sum, divide by 10, round half up (0.5 → 1). The stat behind an element comes from elements.json (Vitality / World / Matter / Will). `caster` and `defender` are unit objects, `elements` an element-id list. NOTE: the iterating body only sees the current element, so pass unit / list arguments as {"root": "..."} references (e.g. {"caster": {"root": "caster"}}).

entries.name: Rule 20 — point-buy dice count
entries.description: How many d6 a point-buy rolls for a stat: the n with 6·n nearest the stat, ties going to more dice (Matter 15 → 3 dice, 8 → 1, 9 → 2). Minimum one die.

entries.name: Rule 20 — point-buy roll succeeds
entries.description: The rolled dice sum must stay at or under the stat; the highest die becomes the token value. A failed roll means the emission repeats next action (Rule 20 'contiguous action'). Permanents (Rule 12) may re-roll until it fits.

entries.name: Rule 20 — token value of a point-buy
entries.description: The highest die of a successful roll is the token's value (and the power an enemy must beat under Rule 24).

entries.name: Stat buy — bank covers the need
entries.description: Channeling effects (Summoning, Golems, Elementals, Resurrect) bank the caster's stat for the element going out each emission (the card's elements in turn). The cast completes when the bank is at least the need (creature stat sum, or the card's fixed total 24 / 30).

entries.name: Stat buy — emissions to pay the need
entries.description: Upper bound of emissions a stat buy takes at the caster's current stats: need divided by the smallest stat the card's elements bank, rounded up. The UI uses this for the k/n cast length. NOTE: the iterating body only sees the current element, so pass unit / list arguments as {"root": "..."} references (e.g. {"caster": {"root": "caster"}}).

entries.name: Life from the stat sum
entries.description: A unit's life (hits) is its stat sum divided by 10, rounded half up: 40 → 4, 80 → 8, 55 → 6.

entries.name: Stat sum
entries.description: vitality + world + matter + will — the creature's 'Stats' a Summoning or Resurrect must pay.

entries.name: In contact (adjacent hex)
entries.description: Two units are in contact when their hexes are at distance 1 (Rule 7 / Rule 15: Attack, Block, Posture, Move all resolve against units in contact).

entries.name: In view (visible area)
entries.description: The visible area is 10 hexes around the caster (reveal radius). Ranged effects (Meteor Shower, Aura ∀, Summoning ∀ bind) reach everything in view.

entries.name: Is an enemy
entries.description: True when exactly one of the two alliances is npc_b (the monster side).

entries.name: Is an ally
entries.description: Negation of is_enemy for two different units.

entries.name: Rule 20 — which actions may cast a non-instant effect
entries.description: Only Posture and Empty Posture emit elements; Move and Empty Move interrupt a cast (Rule 19) except for classes that carry it (Monk). Instants ride any action.

entries.name: Disable — none of the cast's elements is barred
entries.description: A Disable that fired bars one element to the enemy for the rest of the turn (∀: to everyone). A cast may not emit a barred element. NOTE: the iterating body only sees the current element, so pass unit / list arguments as {"root": "..."} references (e.g. {"caster": {"root": "caster"}}).

entries.name: Resolution matrix edge
entries.description: Bonus damage an actor's action gains over the defender's: Attack beats Posture, Posture beats Move, Move beats Block, Block beats Attack (1 each); base damage 1 for Attack, 0 otherwise. Empty actions resolve as the enemy prefers (battle_system empty_resolution_rule): Attack treats EP as Posture (A vs EP = 2), Posture treats EP as Empty Move (1), Block treats EM as Move (1); Move/Block vs EP and Attack/Posture vs EM are neutral. Pass actor and defender action codes.

entries.name: Rule 10 — draw up to the hand size
entries.description: At the end of a turn the hand is refilled to 5 cards (Haste ∀: +1 per turn; Balefire: +5 at once when it lands).

entries.name: Rule 11 — the deck never goes under 15 cards
entries.description: Archiving a card (archive instead of discard) is allowed only while deck + discard + hand + holding stays at least 15 afterwards.

entries.name: Rule 23 — ∀ double cast
entries.description: Two copies of one effect queued together form one chained cast of cost + 1 emissions and unlock the card's `every_bonus` (∀). The shared element is emitted once (Rule 22).

entries.name: Rule 8 (pc override) — a no-benefit instant returns to hand
entries.description: Instants are committed with the action. If the round's maths gave the player no benefit (took no less damage, dealt no more, healed no more than without it) the card returns to the hand instead of being discarded. Applies to bonus-round instants too.

entries.name: Element ids
entries.description: The ten elements of elements.json. Anything else in an element_cost is a typo or a fork.

entries.name: Action codes
entries.description: A Attack, B Block, M Move, P Posture, EP Empty Posture, EM Empty Move.

entries.name: Effect type tags
entries.description: effect_types vocabulary: damage | instant | point_buy | permanent | channeling | stat_buy | shield_token | relocate | scout | trap (paper data) + buff | debuff | lock | zone | counter | utility | summon | heal | movement | ally (engine rule table).

entries.name: Proposal carries a version, a parent and an origin
entries.description: Governance: never edit a version in place — a proposal is a NEW version object with `version`, `parent_version` (the canonical it derives from, null only for a brand-new entry), `origin` and status 'proposal'. Origin "user_ruling" (optionally suffixed _YYYY-MM-DD) is accepted for rulings by the game owner.

entries.name: Proposal has a data payload
entries.description: `data` must be an object (the mechanical payload; shape per collection).

entries.name: Effect — element_cost holds only real elements
entries.description: Every element in the cost is one of the ten elements; the list may repeat an element (Fireball: fire, fire).

entries.name: Effect — effect_types from the vocabulary
entries.description: effect_types is a non-empty list of known type tags.

entries.name: Effect — 1 to 4 elements
entries.description: An effect costs at least one element and at most four (the paper's longest chains); a stat-buy effect may also carry stat_buy_total ≥ 1.

entries.name: Skill — action_type is an action code or '*'
entries.description: A skill rides on one action type (A/B/M/P) or on any ('*', trance skills).

entries.name: Action — code from the vocabulary
entries.description: code is a battle code (A B M P EP EM) or an upper-case meta code (COMBO, TRADE, ENTER, DOOR …); the rps lists only name battle codes.

entries.name: Class — colours are elements, 1 to 3 of them
entries.description: A class card is cast with a 6-token per colour (Rule 9); colours are element ids, 1 to 10 of them (the paper classes span 2–8).

entries.name: Unit — four non-negative integer stats
entries.description: stats has vitality, world, matter, will as integers ≥ 0 (a 0 is allowed: golems have Will 0).

entries.name: Unit — life equals round(stat sum / 10)
entries.description: Life is derived from the stats (life_from_stats); a proposal may not set it freely. Entries that give `life` explicitly must agree with the formula.

entries.name: Character — combo lists action codes, adept element exists
entries.description: combo is a list of action codes; adept_element is an element id.

entries.name: Creature — 1 to 4 actions per round
entries.description: Rule 1: monsters have their own action count, 1..4 (four forces the player to replace one action with Empty Posture).

entries.name: Rule — has a number, a scope and text
entries.description: A rule version must carry its number (string), a scope and non-empty text; cross_refs name rule ids.

entries.name: Terrain item — kind from the vocabulary
entries.description: kind ∈ tower | crystal | mine | nexus | trade_center | stash | door | library | wall | artifact | terrain | puzzle_building | tile | token | resource | trap | gate (the paper data uses the first twelve).

entries.name: Game mode — player count and tileset make sense
entries.description: player_count is at least 1 and time_per_turn_s positive when given.

entries.name: Power score — effect
entries.description: governance_rebalance_script: expected_damage_per_action + 0.5·|effect_types| + 0.25·permanent + 0.5·channeling + 1.0·every_bonus − 0.3·|element_cost|. expected_damage_per_action = Rule 21 delta over the 12 characters' average stat spread ≈ Σ per element of max(mean_caster − mean_defender, 0)/10; with symmetric characters that is 0, so the script uses 0.6 per damaging element as the expected contribution (a 10-point stat edge rounds to 1 about 60% of the time in the character pool). Evaluated with {data} = the version's data.

entries.name: Power score — skill
entries.description: rps_advantage_edges + bonus_damage + permanent_flag·0.5. A skill that rides on a specific action inherits that action's one matrix edge (1); a '*' trance skill counts 1.5; bonus_damage from data.bonus_damage (default 0).

entries.name: Power score — class
entries.description: colors_count·0.4 + ability_power (0..3, hand-tagged in data.ability_power, default by kind: once_per_round 2, tap 1.5, static 1) + draw_bonus·0.5.

entries.name: Power score — creature
entries.description: life + actions_per_round·0.8 + innate_effect_power (1 when the creature has an innate effect, plus 0.5 for an on-action rider).

entries.name: Power score — character
entries.description: sum(stats)/10 + adept_bonus (0.5 when an adept element is set) + combo_coverage (distinct action codes in the combo × 0.25).

entries.name: Rebalance — proposal within tolerance
entries.description: governance_rebalance_script.tolerance.per_entry_relative = 0.15: a proposal passes as-is when |proposal − current| ≤ 0.15·current (or both are 0).

entries.name: The action card is in hand
entries.description: A, B, M, P need their card in the hand; EP and EM never do. The logic blocks read {"var": "caster.hand_has.<code>"}; as a named rule the hand is passed as a code list so the code can be a parameter.

entries.name: Empty Move — halfway toward the target
entries.description: EM walks ceil(dist / 2) hexes along the shortest path (= round(d/2) for integer d), at least 1 when the target is not the actor's own tile. Used by action_empty_move, class_rogue and battle_system_core.

entries.name: Validation — rps lists name exactly the cycle neighbours
entries.description: A battle action's rps_wins_against is exactly [win_code] and rps_loses_against exactly [lose_code] (A>P, P>M, M>B, B>A). Repeated in the four A/B/M/P validations.

entries.name: Validation — no rps edges
entries.description: Empty and meta actions (EP, EM, COMBO, TRADE, ENTER, DOOR) keep both rps lists empty. Repeated in six validations.

entries.name: Damage an attacker takes from a Block
entries.description: B>A scores 1 on an attacker in contact unless the attacker holds Ranged Weapon (then 0). Used from both sides: action_attack.damage_taken_from_block and action_block.combat_damage_per_attacker.

entries.name: Actions per round of a pc character
entries.description: Catalog lookup of battle_system_core.turn_structure.actions_per_round_pc (3) so rules / effects / game modes do not hard-code the number.

entries.name: Validation — the edge list holds (actor > defender) with bonus 1
entries.description: True when some edge of the list has the given actor, defender and bonus_damage_to_actor 1. The 4-cycle validation calls it four times; creatures / game modes that override the matrix can reuse it.

entries.name: Rounding contract check
entries.description: Self-test of the half-up rounding every /10 in the paper uses: 5 → 1, 4 → 0, 0.5 → 1. Cheap regression for custom-op registration; could become a logic_rules example instead.

entries.name: species_sum_rule — playable race Σstats = 40
entries.description: concept.json species_sum_rule: playable races have Σ(stats) = 40.

entries.name: Rule 16 — adept emits with power 20
entries.description: 20 when an adept element is set, else 0 (the plain stat applies).

entries.name: Rule 16 — combo bonus
entries.description: +1 damage when the combo was just completed and an enemy is in contact.

entries.name: Two lists have the same length
entries.description: count(a) == count(b) — combo length unchanged, schedule length unchanged, …

entries.name: Value is null or in the allowed list
entries.description: Used for adept_element / terrain element / innate ids.

entries.name: Class card sits in the permanents
entries.description: Rule 9: the class ability is available only while the class card is among the caster's permanents (it always is for a living character, but creatures and class-less contexts fail it).

entries.name: Class card — one 6-token per colour
entries.description: The class card enters with one token of fixed value 6 (fixed_power_6) per listed colour; this is the count. Pair with fixed_power_6 for the value.

entries.name: Class ability gate by ability_kind
entries.description: User ruling 2026-10-30: tap → the card is untapped (untap by emitting each colour once with ANY successful roll); every other kind (once_per_round, static with a click) → not yet used this ACTION (hg.action). Passive statics (Noble, Assassin, Guardian, Bard, Reaver, Barbarian, Monk, Transmuter, Restaurateur) need no click and never pass through this gate.

used_this_round.description: used this action (hg.action) — the historical name is kept

entries.name: Class card — one colour falls to a 6
entries.description: User ruling 2026-10-30: an adjacent enemy emits one element of a class colour (a colour = the stat group of the listed elements, e.g. the four Matter elements are ONE colour) in a point-buy of that stat; the highest die must be a 6 to strike the colour down. One colour per action, in any order (non-contiguous). Concentration elements not listed on the card are not a colour.

colour_elems.description: the elements of the colour aimed at

entries.name: Class card — every colour down → the card goes to the owner's archive
entries.description: User ruling 2026-10-30: once each colour (stat group) of the class has been struck down the class permanent leaves the board for its OWNER's archive; its statics stop, its ability is gone, the unit list shows every colour en-gray.

colours.description: the stat groups of the class

down.description: the stat groups already struck down

entries.name: Class card — recast / untap complete
entries.description: User ruling 2026-10-30: the owner recasts an archived class (back on the board as initially) or untaps a tapped ability by emitting EVERY colour of the class, one per action, each with any successful point-buy (power 1). Complete when every colour has been emitted.

entries.name: Empty-action stance of the EP classes
entries.description: peer.mjs: a Reaver's EP and EM fight as Attack, a Barbarian's EP as Block, a Monk's EP as Move; everything else is unchanged. Used by class_reaver / class_barbarian / class_monk and by action_empty_posture / action_empty_move.

entries.name: ability_kind vocabulary
entries.description: once_per_round | static | tap (classes.json notes).

entries.name: List length within +-1 of canonical
entries.description: Validation: |count(proposal list) − count(canonical list)| <= 1. Used for class colours; applicable to element_cost, combos and dice patterns too.

entries.name: Heal capped at the missing life
entries.description: min(amount, max0(life_max − life)) — Healer, Guardian, Noble lifesteal, Overlord armor.

entries.name: Catalog — every id in a list resolves
entries.description: True when every id in `ids` names an existing catalog entry (its active data is not null). json-logic's `all` is false for an empty list, so the empty case is allowed explicitly. Used as the sources-exist prerequisite and sources-resolve validation in all contradiction entries; the same shape is inlined for rules' cross_refs (rules.shared.json cross_refs_resolve).

entries.name: Contradiction — sources and resolutions present
entries.description: A contradiction proposal names at least one source entry and proposes at least one resolution. Inlined as sources-non-empty / resolutions-proposed in all 6 entries. Context {proposal}.

entries.name: Contradiction — chosen resolution is one of the proposed
entries.description: chosen_resolution is absent (open vote) or equals the resolution_id of one of proposed_resolutions. Inlined as chosen-is-proposed in all 6 entries. Context {proposal}.

entries.name: Contradiction — a resolved entry keeps its choice
entries.description: Once a contradiction is resolved its chosen_resolution is history: a new version keeps it. Inlined as resolution-kept in the 4 resolved entries. Context {entry, proposal}.

entries.name: Two numbers differ by at most delta
entries.description: abs(a − b) ≤ delta — used four times per creature (each stat ±5) and once per character (stat sum ±5).

entries.name: Unit — each stat within ±5 of canonical
entries.description: Every one of vitality/world/matter/will moved at most 5 between entry.data.stats and proposal.data.stats. Context {entry, proposal}.

entries.name: Creature — dice_pattern null or A/B/M/P letters
entries.description: null means the default BMAP 4d6; otherwise 3–6 face letters.

entries.name: Effect id resolves in the catalog (or is null)
entries.description: innate_effect / dispelable_by style references: null, or {"entry": [id, "element_cost"]} is not null.

entries.name: Creature — on-action rider bonus
entries.description: bonus_damage when the revealed action equals the rider action, else 0.

entries.name: Rule 3 — monster regenerates when unengaged
entries.description: Life restored this turn: life_max − life when no enemy is in contact (dist > 1), 0 otherwise.

entries.name: Rule 5 — dice thrown per action
entries.description: Pattern length, or 4 for the default BMAP set when the pattern is null.

entries.name: Creature — on_action_rider shape
entries.description: null or { action ∈ action codes, bonus_damage 1..3 }. Context {proposal}.

entries.name: Validation — a shape object keeps the named keys
entries.description: subset_of(required, keys(shape)). Used by session_dimension_descriptor (identity_keys_present, tileset_keys_kept, turn_keeps_max_seen), session_door (head_and_members_present, member_item_keys_kept), session_local_state (character_has_four_stats, cards_keep_hand_and_commitment, region_peers_tiers_kept), and the *_present asserts in sync_protocol / hashgraph_events. `required` is a literal array of strings.

entries.name: Door — last push predates the current interval
entries.description: doc.last_push.interval_index < interval_index. Used by session_door.is_stale and sync_join_flow.new_location_needs_stale_door.

entries.name: Door status pattern
entries.description: Regex source for session_door.status: active | stale | merged_into:<DoorId> | closed.

entries.name: DoorId is a magnet URI with the urn:dim topic
entries.description: matches(s, '^magnet:\\?xt=urn:dim:'). Used by session_door.door_identity_present and sync_join_flow.door_id_is_magnet.

entries.name: Cast — declared target within reach (Aura ∀ reaches the view)
entries.description: Standard targeting gate of every target-scope effect (used by ~25 blocks as prerequisite `target_in_reach`): either no target was declared (the engine picks the enemy the cast hurts most within range, Rule 15 pc override) or the right-clicked target is within `range` hexes; a cast flagged `aura` (through an Aura ∀) reaches everything within 10.

entries.name: Cast — declared target is an enemy, or none declared
entries.description: Second half of the standard target gate (prerequisite `target_is_enemy` in every damaging / locking block): a right-clicked target must be an enemy (is_enemy); without a declared target the engine aims at an enemy itself.

entries.name: Rule 20 — total dice a point-buy cast rolls
entries.description: Σ over the cast elements of point_buy_dice_count(caster stat behind the element). Used as effect `point_buy_dice` by every point-buy damage block (Harm, Mind Blast, Drain, Meteor Shower, Blizzard, Ice Blast, Dark Matter) and by the stat-penalty blocks. Iterates: pass caster / elements as {"root": ...}.

entries.name: Rule 20 (pc) — damage of a point-buy cast
entries.description: Σ of the kept dice (one per element, highest die of each successful roll, nulls count 0) ÷10 rounded half up. Used as effect `point_buy_damage` by the seven point-buy damage blocks; the peer subtracts a Force Shield from the Σ before rounding.

entries.name: Rule 23 — actions lost by a lock (doubled on ∀)
entries.description: n actions lost by the hit target, doubled when the cast is a ∀ double cast (Lightning, Space-bending). Effect `actions_lost`.

entries.name: Lock — remaining actions of this turn (+ next turn)
entries.description: Actions a target loses from a rest-of-turn lock: its actions_per_round minus the actions already played (action_index + 1), floored at 0; with next_turn (Oblivion) the whole next turn is added. Used by Fossilization and Oblivion.

entries.name: Rule 24 — power of a unit's token behind an element
entries.description: The highest value among a unit's tokens whose elem matches (null when none). Used as the `power` argument of using_rule_24 in the `destroyed_by_rule_24` effect of every point-buy permanent (Oblivion, Inner Fire, Invisibility, Haste, Aura, Disable, Potion brew, Artifice, …). Iterates: pass the element as {"root": ...}.

entries.name: Stat buy — stat banked at emission k
entries.description: The caster stat behind the card element going out at emission `step` (1-based), card elements round-robin: element index = (step − 1) mod |elements|. Used as effect `stat_buy_bank_this_emission` by the eight stat-buy blocks (Summoning, 3 Golems, 3 Elementals, Resurrect).

entries.name: Rule 23 — ×2 on a ∀ double cast
entries.description: 2 when `every` (two copies chained), else 1. Multiplies locks and the paper's 'power 20 × number of casts' of traps / Creation / Traps mastery.

entries.name: Effect validation — cost keeps its key element
entries.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries the given element (the element family that defines the effect). Used as validation `cost_keeps_key_element` in all 66 blocks.

entries.name: Effect validation — element count within ±1 of canonical
entries.description: |proposal cost| differs from |canonical cost| by at most one. Used as validation `cost_count_within_one` in 59 blocks (the summon families assert the fixed stat_buy_total instead).

entries.name: Effect validation — effect_types keeps a tag
entries.description: The proposal's effect_types still includes the given tag (damage / instant / permanent / stat_buy / channeling / trap / relocate / scout). Used as validation `keeps_type_<tag>` in all 66 blocks.

entries.name: Rule 18 / 21 — one element's stat delta
entries.description: Stat points one element contributes to the Rule 21 sum: max(stat_of(caster, element) − stat_of(defender, element), 0). The per-element body of rule_21_delta_damage; inlined as `delta` in all 10 elements and as element-delta in rule_18_element_emit.

entries.name: Element — may be emitted by this caster
entries.description: The element is not barred by a Disable on the caster and the caster has a positive stat behind it. Inlined as the two prerequisites (not-disabled, caster-has-stat) of all 10 elements. Pass `caster` as {"root": "caster"} (elements_not_disabled iterates).

entries.name: Element — stat column unchanged and reciprocated
entries.description: A new version keeps the element's `stat`, that stat entry exists and its `elements` list names this element, and the element id is one of valid_element_ids. Inlined as stat-unchanged / stat-lists-element / id-valid in all 10 elements. Context {entry, proposal}.

entries.name: Non-empty string
entries.description: typeof x == string and len > 0 — win_condition, matchmaking, theme, notes …

entries.name: Two values have the same typeof
entries.description: typeof(a) == typeof(b) — player_count type unchanged.

entries.name: Two-number range with 0 < min < max
entries.description: round_total_s, building_size_tiles_range — checks count 2, both positive, not equal (order-insensitive via min_of/max_of).

entries.name: Mode time per turn with the Time-management fallback
entries.description: The mode's own time_per_turn_s, or mode_time_management.per_action_s when null.

entries.name: Governance — weight of one vote
entries.description: governance_voting.vote_weight_formula: min(0.10, 0.01 x (1 + log2(1 + times_used_in_dimension)) x (1 + 0.1 x dimensions_played_in)). json-logic has no log2, so the caller passes log2_1p_times_used = log2(1 + times_used_in_dimension) (0 for an unused entry, 1 for once, 3 for 7 uses).

entries.name: Governance — tally weight of a proposal
entries.description: clamp(sum(+1 weights) - sum(-1 weights), 0, 1) (governance_voting.proposal_lifecycle[1]). Pass the two weight lists.

entries.name: Governance — accept_threshold for a collection
entries.description: governance_voting.per_collection_overrides.<collection>.accept_threshold when present, else governance_voting.accept_threshold. Read via catalog lookup so it follows the active version.

entries.name: Governance — quorum_voters for a collection
entries.description: governance_voting.per_collection_overrides.<collection>.quorum_voters when present, else governance_voting.quorum_voters.

entries.name: Governance — status decision at tally time
entries.description: canonical when weight >= accept AND voters >= quorum AND age_s >= min_age_s AND within tolerance; rejected when weight <= reject_threshold OR (age_s > max_age_s AND voters < quorum); otherwise proposal. Thresholds default to governance_voting's canonical numbers; `raw_weight` is the unclamped sum(+w) - sum(-w) so the negative reject_threshold can be reached, `weight` the clamped tally.

entries.name: Collection ids of the data layer
entries.description: The 18 governed collections of data/index.json (logic_rules excluded: it has no write policy). Used by governance_voting.overrides_name_known_collections and governance_write_permissions (collections_are_known_ids, every_collection_covered, uncovered_collections).

entries.name: Cadence — an interval has passed since the last run
entries.description: now_s - last_s >= interval_s. Used by governance_branch_layout.release_due, governance_voting.tally_due, governance_rebalance_script.run_due, sync_radicle_push.interval_elapsed.

entries.name: Validation — an object keeps exactly the canonical key set
entries.description: count(keys(proposal_obj)) == count(keys(current_obj)) and every proposal key is a canonical key. Used 13x as payload_keys_unchanged (hashgraph_events), 3x as shape_keys_unchanged (dimension_session), plus sync_handshake_per_action.envelope_keys_unchanged, sync_turn_commit.payload_keys_unchanged, sync_radicle_push.paths_keys_unchanged, governance_branch_layout.branch_names_unchanged, governance_rebalance_script.power_score_collections_unchanged. Pass the objects as {"var": ...} references.

entries.name: Hashgraph event scopes
entries.description: The scope vocabulary of hashgraph_events: dimension | door | strong_region. Used by every event's scope_in_vocabulary validation; a collection_validation candidate for hashgraph_events.

entries.name: Hashgraph event — scope from the vocabulary and unchanged
entries.description: proposal.data.scope is in valid_event_scopes and equals entry.data.scope; finality text unchanged. Candidate for collection_validation.hashgraph_events.

entries.name: Hashgraph event — envelope type / scope / emitter / payload keys match the entry
entries.description: The four prerequisites every event block repeats: envelope.type == entry.id, scope == entry.data.scope, emitter.role == entry.data.emitted_by, and every contract payload key is present in envelope.payload. Context: {envelope, scope, emitter, entry}.

entries.name: Handshake — expected members whose envelope is still missing
entries.description: count(filter(expected, not in seen)). Used by evt_action_commit.members_outstanding; the complement of all_members_answered (sync_protocol.shared.json). Pass `seen` as {"root": ...} because the body iterates.

entries.name: Shared-salt D6
entries.description: 1 + (digest mod 6) where digest is sha256(concat(salts) + roll_index) read as an integer by the runtime (json-logic cannot hash). Used by sync_handshake_per_action.die_from_salts and evt_dice.die_from_digest.

entries.name: Rule — proposal keeps number and scope
entries.description: Every new version of a paper rule keeps the rule number and the scope of the canonical version. Inlined as validation items keeps-number / keeps-scope in all 26 rule entries. Context {entry, proposal}.

entries.name: Rule — text longer than a minimum
entries.description: The rule text of a proposal is longer than `min` characters (default 40; the collection rule rule_has_text only asks for 20). Inlined as text-long-enough in all 26 rule entries.

data.text: A rule text that is comfortably longer than forty characters.

entries.name: Rule — cross_refs name existing entries
entries.description: proposal.data.cross_refs holds at most `max` ids and every id resolves to a catalog entry (rules, actions, effects ...). json-logic's `all` is false on an empty list, hence the explicit empty guard. Inlined as cross-refs-resolve in all 26 rule entries; the same shape serves contradictions' source_entries (see contradictions.shared.json entries_exist).

entries.name: Rule 1 / 7 — forced Empty Postures
entries.description: Actions a unit must fill with Empty Posture because its opponent has more actions per round: max(opponent − own, 0). A forced EP cannot be converted to Empty Move. Inlined in rule_1_actions_per_round and rule_7_turn_round_sequence.

entries.name: Rule 0 — tileset size by player count
entries.description: Tiles in the Dimension tileset: 12 (3x4) for up to 2 players, 16 (4x4) for 3, 25 (5x5) for 4 or more. Inlined in rule_0_setup and its superseded mirror rule_25_tileset_initial_deploy.

entries.name: Cast — the element being emitted now
entries.description: elements[cast.step] read from the root context: the element the current Posture emits. json-logic evaluates the `var` path argument, so a dynamic path is built with `cat`. Inlined four times in rule_18_element_emit and rule_20_effect_types.

entries.name: Skill rides on the action family
entries.description: A skill with action_type `family` may be played when the caster's action is that code, or — for Move and Posture skills — an empty action (EP / EM), per peer.mjs ridesFor(). Repeated in every one of the 14 skill prerequisites.

entries.name: Permanent not already in the holding
entries.description: A permanent skill / effect may only be played while it is not yet among the caster's permanents. Used by the 5 permanent skills; the effects collection has the same need.

entries.name: Target is an enemy in contact
entries.description: in_contact AND is_enemy — the single most repeated prerequisite across skills, classes and actions (A-skills, Bluff, Counter Spell, Priest, Witch, Manipulator, Avenger, Attack, Combo).

entries.name: Target is an ally (or self) in contact
entries.description: in_contact AND is_ally — Healer, Overlord, Warrior, Transmuter, Trade.

entries.name: Rule 8 pc override over the `outcome` context
entries.description: rule_8_instant_returns bound to the round-maths context the resolver supplies: outcome.took_with / took_without / dealt_with / dealt_without (healed_* default 0). Repeated verbatim in the 9 non-permanent skills.

entries.name: point_buy_stat vocabulary
entries.description: Values a skill's point_buy_stat may take besides null: 'any' (roll against the highest stat) or a stat key in either spelling the data uses (stat_vitality … / vitality …). Used in all 14 skill validations.

entries.name: Highest of the four stats
entries.description: The stat an 'any' point-buy rolls against (Sanctuary placement, Druid defence token): max(vitality, world, matter, will).

entries.name: Two lists hold the same values
entries.description: True when `a` and `b` are subsets of each other (order and duplicates ignored). json-logic's `==` compares arrays by reference, so list equality needs this. Inlined for zero_in (4 stats) and for the concept's pillars.

entries.name: Stat — elements are real, distinct and map back
entries.description: proposal.data.elements is a non-empty, duplicate-free subset of valid_element_ids and every listed element's own `stat` column names this stat entry (entry.id). Inlined as elements-valid + elements-map-back in all 4 stats. Context {entry, proposal}; uses root inside `all`.

entries.name: Stat — code, pillar role and zero_in unchanged
entries.description: A new version of a pillar keeps its code, pillar_role and the zero_in set. Inlined as code-unchanged / pillar-role-unchanged / zero-in-unchanged in all 4 stats. Context {entry, proposal}.

entries.name: Sync — two units share a strong region
entries.description: hex_distance(a.tile, b.tile) <= sync_region_tiers.tiers[0].strong_radius_tiles. Used by sync_region_tiers (membership, promotion, strong_region_members), sync_handshake_per_action (actor_in_strong_region), evt_action_commit (action_in_strong_region). Pass tiles as {q,r}.

entries.name: Sync — tier name for a hex distance
entries.description: strong when dist <= strong radius, reachable when dist <= reach, far otherwise (peer.mjs tierOf). Used by sync_region_tiers.tier_of_peer and the UI roster.

entries.name: Handshake — every expected member sent its envelope
entries.description: subset_of(expected, seen). Used by sync_handshake_per_action.phase_may_advance, evt_action_commit.all_committed, evt_instant.window_closed, evt_state_hash.all_reveals_in_or_expired, evt_genesis / evt_merge finality (signers), evt_join.accepted.

entries.name: Handshake — silent member is resolved as Empty Posture
entries.description: 'EP' once elapsed_s >= handshake_timeout_s (sync_region_tiers.failure_mode / rule_6), null while the window is open. Used by sync_handshake_per_action and evt_action_commit.

entries.name: Radicle — push interval index
entries.description: floor(unix_time / radicle_push_interval_s). Used by sync_radicle_push (interval_index, next_push_at_s, fallback_deadline_s, is_elected_pusher_or_fallback) and evt_radicle_push.

entries.name: Radicle — artefact path under ActiveDimensions/<DimensionName>/
entries.description: cat('ActiveDimensions/', dimension_name, '/', rest). Used by sync_radicle_push (door_path, dimension_descriptor_path, runtime_door_path), evt_radicle_push.commit_path, session_dimension_descriptor.descriptor_path, session_door.door_path, governance_branch_layout.dimension_branch_name.

entries.name: Sync — the Dimension turn is the max seen
entries.description: max(mine, max_of(peers' turns)). Used by sync_turn_commit.dimension_turn, evt_turn_commit.dimension_turn, sync_divergence_merge.merged_turn, evt_merge.turn_adopted, sync_radicle_push.merged_dimension_turn, session_dimension_descriptor.merged_turn.

entries.name: Two objects have the same key set
entries.description: subset_of(keys(a), keys(b)) and subset_of(keys(b), keys(a)) — payload / requirement / yields key sets unchanged.

entries.name: Number > 0 within ±50 % of canonical (null-tolerant)
entries.description: If the canonical is null the proposal may be null or any positive number; otherwise it must be > 0 and within ±50 % (within_tolerance relative 0.5). Used for every numeric tunable (requirement.min, stat_bonus, gold_per_turn, per_action_s, deck_size …).

entries.name: Unit stands on the tile
entries.description: dist ≤ 0 — using a tower / crystal / mine / library / stash requires standing on it.

entries.name: Tower — stat behind the element ≥ min, or adept
entries.description: stat_of(caster, element) ≥ min, or or_adept and the caster's adept element is the tower element.

entries.name: Per-day use left
entries.description: uses_today < per_day (nexus hire/raid, trade center barter, stash redeploy).

entries.name: Caster tokens cover the required elements
entries.description: subset_of(required, map(tokens, elem)) — a mine's requires_permanents are all present among the caster's tokens (presence, not multiplicity).

entries.name: Rule 2 — trap power of an effect-only tile
entries.description: 20 per element used in the effects lying on the tile.

entries.name: General UX — Instant commits
entries.description: If you commit an action marked instant, no standard action (A, B, M, P, EP/EM) is spent, but an effect commits the element you emit this round and does not end your round. Example: Teleport cast with ∀ (two in hand, both auto-selected) lets you commit a distant location (emitting Space) then continue the round. The character emits Space the whole round, so you cannot start another cast whose first element differs (e.g. Mind Blast first-element Concentration). You may play any basic action, any skill, and any effect whose first element is Space. Movement does not actually happen until the resolution phase — committing a tile earlier in the turn only reserves the plan.

entries.name: General UX — target of a close-range effect
entries.description: When you are adjacent to an enemy you may right-click them to mark them as the current target; the target survives this round / turn until you right-click another enemy or tile. An effect you cast reuses that target by default. When you select the effect / skill / class / permanent ability you may left-click a target to override it. If you do not — press Space to commit, or let the 6-second timer fire — the target is picked automatically to give you the most benefit; a prior right-click target is the first priority.

entries.name: General UX — target of a ranged effect
entries.description: For an effect that targets a distant tile (Teleport, Sound Wave, …) selecting the effect (left-click or shortcut) lets you then pick its target tile instead of using the right-click adjacency target. If you commit via Space, or the 6-second auto-commit fires, a random tile within 10 hexes is chosen so as to maximise your benefit.

entries.name: General UX — token uniqueness and auto-pick
entries.description: Only ONE token per element can sit on your permanent holdings and ONE tile token per element on a given tile — attempting to place another overrides the existing one only if its value is larger (same for tile tokens on any location). When a cast is about to create a token, your Hero Stats become clickable; you can pick the stat yourself, and if not the system picks the most beneficial element for you (e.g. if most of your deck emits Fire it picks Fire for a Matter stat). See [[general_ux_token_generated]] for naturally-placed tokens.

entries.name: General UX — world-generated terrain tokens and artefacts
entries.description: Implemented 2026-10-30 (map.js featureAt, user ruling "it is part of dimension terrain generation and map discovery"): every hex derives from (dimension seed, q, r) whether it carries a terrain-region token (Grove / Graveyard / Ruins / Void Scar / Highland / Marsh / Rockfield / Ashfield / Monastery Grounds / Meadow — one element each, value 1–4, patches over 4-hex cells) or a building / artefact (Shrine, Sphere of Fire, Healing Spring, School, Academy, Sacred Land, Obelisk of Time, Rift, Windmill, Well, Standing Stones, the four Crystals, Artifact — value 3–6), about one feature per 5 hexes, none within 2 hexes of the origin. They are bonus tile tokens owned by "world": a stat bonus and life-maximum shift while standing on them, Force Pull / Rule 24 / Restaurateur / Metaphysics / Disruption / Mind Blast work on them, and what players did to them travels in every peer's world_edits_json (gone / moved). The paper's special building rules (Shrine barring Attacks, healing every 3 turns, Schools teaching) are NOT modelled — every feature is a flat element value. Related reworks: Artifice (local element token), Ageing (library artefact nearby), Space Bending (random library trap within 10).

entries.name: General UX — emit against a stat to destroy a permanent or token
entries.description: Instead of casting an effect you may point-buy destroy by double-clicking an enemy stat in the visible creature list. That emits a point-buy against that enemy for that stat. If you choose Matter the engine first targets their Matter permanents, then their matching tokens. One emit = one target. Only with an active Aura permanent may a stat emission simultaneously feed an effect and a destroy attempt; the automatic destroy pass then picks the enemy whose permanent or token matches the element you emitted.

entries.name: General UX — channeling effects become breakable temporary permanents
entries.description: Whenever an effect is marked "Point buy (channelling)" (Harm, Combustion, The Void, Light/Darkness today), its cast turns the card into a temporary permanent whose power equals the MIN die rolled in the cast's point-buy. The channel keeps firing its (non-permanent, non-emission) leg every subsequent action until the caster BREAKS concentration — moves (M), Blocks (B), Attacks (A), empty-moves (EM), or emits any element other than the channel's cost element (starts another cast with a non-matching first element, or point-buys to destroy a permanent / token of a different element). Breaking it drops the permanent; it is also destructible by Rule 24 against its min-die power.

entries.name: General UX — life maximum follows stats and tokens
entries.description: Life maximum = round_half_up((Σ base stats + Σ stat tokens + Σ bonus tile tokens under the unit + Σ Spirit-Link stats) ÷ 10), recomputed at every resolution; current life shifts by the same delta (never below 1 while alive). Example: 40 + Harmony token 5 + Sacred land 6 − Vitality penalty 3 → 48 → 5.

token_values.description: signed values of every token / link that counts for the unit

entries.name: Invisibility breaks
entries.description: User ruling 2026-11-14: the Invisibility permanent is destroyed (and its holder is seen already in that action) when the holder uses Attack or Block (a Battle Trance option counts; a Reaver's Empty Posture / Empty Move fights as Attack) or emits for any effect other than Invisibility (any cast emission, instants and bonus plans included). Moving, a bare Posture, Empty actions, skills and Rule 24 destroy emissions keep it. Mirrors game/effects.mjs invisibilityBreaks().

action.description: Action code the holder played (A, B, M, P, EM, EP, BT).

effect_id.description: Effect the holder emits for this action, or null.

reaver.description: The holder is a Reaver (EP / EM fight as Attack).

entries.name: Avenger chase bonus
entries.description: User rework #2 2026-11-14: life points the Avenger gains (to life max AND life) when `fresh` monsters started chasing it this action while it already holds `bonus` chase-bonus points; never more than `max` (1) in total. A point lost to damage is granted again by the next new chaser. Mirrors game/class-chase.mjs chaseBonusStep().grant.

fresh.description: Monsters that started chasing the Avenger now (not chasing at the last resolution).

bonus.description: Chase-bonus points the Avenger holds now (0..max).

max.description: Cap of the bonus (class data chase_bonus.max).

entries.name: Monster effect affordable
entries.description: User ruling 2026-11-15 (rule_monster_deck_effects): an effect card is cheap enough for a monster when it has 1..max_len elements, every element is backed by a stat ≥ min_stat (the point-buy rolls mostly succeed) and — for delta damage (Rule 21) — the mean of those stats is ≥ min_stat_delta (else it deals 0 to a hero). element_stats = the monster stat behind each element of the card, in cost order. Mirrors game/monster-deck.mjs affordable().

element_stats.description: The monster stat behind each element of the effect (ELEM_TO_STAT).

delta.description: The effect deals delta damage (damage type without point_buy).

min_stat_delta.description: Least mean stat for delta damage.

entries.name: Monster deck_effects valid
entries.description: User ruling 2026-11-15 (rule_monster_deck_effects): a creature version either has no deck_effects (an older version) or exactly `count` distinct effect ids (data.monster_deck.thematic, 4).

deck_effects.description: The creature version's deck_effects (effect ids) or null.

count.description: How many thematic effects a creature holds.

entries.name: Natural Love / Awe / Fear / Anger damage gate
entries.description: User rulings 2026-11-15 (rule_monster_natural_permanents): an attacker afflicted by a monster's natural permanent (it came in contact, has not visited its tower since, and the monster still holds a copy) deals no damage: Love / Awe — not to that monster; Fear — to nobody; Anger — to anyone but that monster while in contact with it. Self-damage is never blocked. Mirrors game/natural-perms.mjs naturalDamageBlock().

kind.description: the affliction: effect_love | effect_awe | effect_fear | effect_anger

victim_is_holder.description: the damage would land on the afflicting monster

in_contact_with_holder.description: the attacker stands next to the afflicting monster

entries.name: Natural Creation ward
entries.description: User rulings 2026-11-15: while a monster holds its natural Creation, an enemy whose Matter is below the monster's cannot enter a hex next to it (dist ≤ 1). Mirrors game/natural-perms.mjs creationBars().
